svg.title: Portlink: a local preview, opened on your phone
svg.desc: A terminal opens port 3000 with a fifteen-minute lifetime. Portlink returns a private HTTPS address and QR code. A phone on Tailscale opens the preview. A local app, a build directory or one file can be shared; expiry stops only that preview's route.

g.text: HTTPS, a QR code and a lifetime. One command.
The same app, on your phone.
